name: Aparthotel Bergland
beschreibung: The Aparthotel Bergland in Söll is a hotel-category accommodation located in the town of Söll in Tyrol, Austria. The establishment offers apartments with bedrooms, living areas, and kitchens in various sizes, ideal for couples or families. The property includes a wellness area featuring a sauna, steam bath, and relaxation lounge. In summer, guests can enjoy a sunbathing area with an outdoor pool. Breakfast is served in the hotel’s in-house restaurant. Thanks to its location in the Söllland, it’s conveniently close to hiking and skiing resorts.
